title: Example Track: pre-master checklist
verdict: Invented numbers, for showing the format only.
Level and peaks leave room for mastering.
Low end is centered. The kick and bass need a closer look.

moves.do: Sidechain the bass to the kick: ratio 3:1, fast attack, medium release.
moves.why: The sub share jumps on every kick hit, so the two parts fight for the same room.
moves.check: Bounce again. The sub peak should look steadier and the kick should hit harder at the same level.

moves.do: If you add glue compression, keep it to 2 to 3 dB of gain reduction.
moves.why: More than that changes the feel, not just the glue.
moves.check: Bypass it at the same loudness and compare.

moves.do: Check the mix on small speakers or headphones.
moves.why: Near-field monitors cannot show what happens below about 50 Hz.

watch: The report cannot hear tone, groove, or taste.
Tempo can be half or double. Confirm it in your session.
questions: Is this going to mastering, or is it the final?
